reason: Owner removed the false equivalence between global Ext and local finite-free sheaf Ext; P¹ with F=O and G=O(-2) is a counterexample to that old clause. The corrected definition uses O-module injectives supplied by the ready local lemma, then takes global Hom cohomology for Ext and internal-Hom sheaf cohomology for sheaf Ext. Published injective comparison maps and homotopies make both constructions independent of supplied resolutions; AC supplies those resolutions and implies the DC comparison qualification. No finite-free local formula or enough-projectives theorem is assumed.
